title: What do these four token additions give?
description: Four additions are done with positive and negative tokens, the same way as the lift attendant's pocket in the book. Tokens of one kind pile up, and mixed tokens make zero pairs that are taken away. The tokens left give each sum and its sign.
teaching_notes: One idea: when both numbers have the same sign, add them; when the signs differ, cancel zero pairs and read the tokens left. Watch for students who forget the sign of the tokens that are left.

video_script.why: The child adds four pairs of integers with tokens, by the method of the lift attendant's pocket.
video_script.substitution: Join tokens of one kind; for mixed tokens, match zero pairs, take them away and read the tokens left.
video_script.anchor: positive and negative tokens on the board
video_script.payoff_line: The four sums are positive ten, negative five, negative two and positive four.

final_answer.spoken: positive ten, negative five, negative two and positive four

maths_rules: (+5) + (−7): 5 zero pairs, 7 − 5 = 2 negative tokens stay, so −2
(−2) + (+6): 2 zero pairs, 6 − 2 = 4 positive tokens stay, so +4
check: 2 negative tokens + 5 zero pairs = 7 negative and 5 positive tokens; 4 positive tokens + 2 zero pairs = 6 positive and 2 negative tokens
video_script.design: Four additions on one board, each drawn as green positive tokens and red negative tokens. Zero pairs are ringed and taken away. The check puts the zero pairs back.
